scope: Refresh 31 exact blocking advisory fingerprints after an Amazon severity entry appeared; preserve every projector, identity, component prerequisite and raw finding.
original_native_result: failure with 31 unresolved advisory fingerprints; preserved unchanged

comparison.reviewed_blocking_delta: Only /VendorSeverity/amazon added with value 3; active SeveritySource remains ubuntu.
comparison.full_report_note: The remaining metadata differences are retained as raw evidence; this policy update reviews only the 31 blocking entries.

vendor_aggregation_caveat.meaning: Trivy aggregate VendorSeverity is preserved as received, not treated as an authoritative Amazon classification or applicability proof.
vendor_aggregation_caveat.observation: Amazon pages display Medium for CVE-2026-98621 and Low for CVE-2026-98626, while this Trivy feed adds numeric value 3 for both. No raw data is corrected or removed.

limitations: This record does not change the historical native failure or the successful hosted producer result.
New evaluator acceptance requires a separate receipt over the same immutable image and complete raw report.
An exact new fingerprint intentionally does not accept either the old fingerprint or a future changed advisory.
The 30 absent-kernel-code conclusions apply only to verified exported-header image payloads, not the host kernel.
CVE-2026-98626 additionally requires the separately repaired installed libbpf library and provenance; a headers-only rationale is insufficient.
No private image, deployment, runner registration, or site runtime is authorized by this source review.
